title: cachedb_sql Module
content_markdown: This module is an implementation of a cache system designed to work with a regular SQL-based server. It uses the internal DB interface to connect to the back-end, and also implements the Key-Value interface exported from the core.
overview: This module is an implementation of a cache system designed to work with a regular SQL-based server. It uses the internal DB interface to connect to the back-end, and also implements the Key-Value interface exported from the core.

exported_parameters.name: cachedb_url
exported_parameters.description:
The url of the Database that OpenSIPS will connect to in order to use the from script cache_store,cache_fetch, etc operations.

The format to follow is : sql:[conn_id]-dburl

The parameter can be set multiple times to create multiple connections accessible from the OpenSIPS script.

exported_parameters.name: db_table
exported_parameters.description: The table of the Database that OpenSIPS will connect to in order to use the from script cache_store,cache_fetch, etc operations.

exported_parameters.name: key_column
exported_parameters.description: The column where the key will be stored

exported_parameters.name: value_column
exported_parameters.description: The column where the value will be stored

exported_parameters.name: counter_column
exported_parameters.description: The column where the counter value will be stored

exported_parameters.name: expires_column
exported_parameters.description: The column where the expires will be stored

exported_parameters.name: cache_clean_period
exported_parameters.description: The interval in seconds at which the expired keys will be removed from the database.
